title: Stop lets a krn-lane subagent with zero commits pass on any merged verdict
body: A subagent ending `verdict: merged <base-sha>` passes Stop unchecked: shippedMerge only checks that the sha is on the base, not that it carries the lane's commits (src/hook/stop.ts:1394-1400, 2042-2043).

Evidence: an external Gemini audit (2026-11-20) wrote the reproduction .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d4-*.test.ts; it fails by assertion on main 1856e2d, and an independent krn-reader pass confirmed the premise and the expected behaviour against the source.
Outcome: the reproduction becomes the regression test at the lowest layer that shows the defect (KRN-14) and passes; the fix names the defect class in Root cause and Redesign lines (KRN-15).

Files: src/hook/stop.ts, test/hook/stop.test.ts
Proof: node --test .krn/runs/gemini-audit/d4-stop-shipped-bypass.test.ts fails by assertion on the base and passes after the fix
